agent_output.vulnerability: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Kedro ShelveStore
agent_output.description: Kedro's ShelveStore uses Python's shelve module, which wraps pickle for serialization. When reading session data from disk, shelve.open() with flag='r' automatically unpickles any stored values. If an attacker can place a malicious shelve database file at the expected path (e.g., by crafting a session directory), the read() method will execute arbitrary code during deserialization. This is a classic pickle RCE via untrusted data.
